messages.text: is the harlo pool for bitcon cash legit?
Read harlolabs.com
Handed to the team · Cannot confirm a BCH pool in Harlo OS from product facts and could not read harl

I don't want to guess on that one. I can't confirm from here what the Harlo OS pool list points at for Bitcoin Cash, and I'd rather JD tell you exactly than have me speculate.

I've put it to him alongside your solo pool question. He's on today, so you can stay in this chat or take the answer at (email hidden)

Fastest route if you want it now: our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post there and mention @nullhashrate, that's JD.
I got an email from you guys... I just want to make sure its real and not a scam
Used the store-orders skill

Good instinct to check. Two things that tell you fast.

Our emails come from (email hidden) or (email hidden), and we never ask for card numbers, a wallet transfer, or a payment outside the store's own checkout. If it asks for any of that, it isn't us.

JD and Georges were due to write to you about the pool pick and your M2 Pros, so an email today is likely ours.

What's the sender address on it, and what does it ask you to do?
thank you i'll wait

Sounds good. JD has it today, so you should see his reply in your inbox.

If anything in that email looks off, forward it or paste it here and I'll tell you straight away whether it came from us.

One thing I'm curious about: what made you doubt it, was it the sender address or something in the wording?
this is where it came from: (email hidden)

That's one of ours. Abel is on the team here, and heliumdeploy.com is our domain, so an email from (email hidden) is genuine.

Only thing to keep in mind: spelling matters. Anything like heliumdeploy-support.com or a .net version is not us.

What did he write about? Happy to pick it up here if it's something I can sort for you.
a lot of scams out there, I just wanted to make sure

You were right to check. In crypto hardware especially, people get fake "support" mails all the time.

Rule of thumb with us: we'll never ask you to send coins, share a seed phrase, or pay anywhere other than the store's own checkout. If a message ever asks for that, it isn't from us, whatever the name on it says.

Anything from Abel or JD, just ask me here and I'll confirm it.
its a giveaway every 4 hours if we join your pool

That one I can't confirm, and I don't want to tell you it's fine when I don't know it. A giveaway every four hours for joining a pool isn't something I have any record of us running, and that pattern is a classic crypto scam, even when the sender looks right.

Please don't click anything in it or enter a wallet address for now.

Let me get the team to confirm whether that mail is genuinely ours.
Handed to the team · Cannot verify the campaign exists; possible spoofed sender.

The team has it and someone will jump into this chat shortly. Stay here if you can, and if you step away the answer comes to your email.

If you can paste the exact text or the link it points to, that will make it quick to settle.
stratum+tcp://pool.harlolabs.com:8888

Thanks, that helps. It's on the harlolabs.com domain, which is our firmware side, but I still won't vouch for it until the team confirms the pool and that giveaway are ours. That's with them now.

One thing that may ease your mind: a stratum address only receives your hashrate. Your payout address stays yours and nothing can be pulled from a wallet by pointing a miner at a pool. The risk with these mails is where the reward is supposed to land, not the pool line itself.
yea i was wondering how that works... because they are giving away hardware.. lets say I win... how would they know where to send the hardware

Good question, and it's the right one to ask. A pool only sees your worker name, your payout address and your hashrate. It has no idea who you are or where you live, so a prize would have to come back to you some other way, usually the email or account you signed up with.

Big red flag to watch for: if a "win" ever asks you to pay a shipping fee, a deposit or a gas fee to release it, that's a scam every time.

The team will confirm how that giveaway actually works.
sounds good... I just wanted to make sure before I change the pool in my hardware

Sensible. Wait for the team's word before you point the miner at it.

Worth noting too: write down your current pool URL, port, worker and password before you change anything, so you can put it back in a minute if you decide against it.

The team will confirm here, and it also lands in your email if you step away.
thank you... I had severy questions before and they never got to me... they also say they would give me a 50 dollar off and i never got it either... but I appreciate your help

I'm sorry, that's twice we've left you waiting, and you've been buying from us since 2022. That shouldn't happen.

I can't see a $50 code on your side from here, so I won't promise one I can't confirm. I'm putting it to the team with the pool email so they settle both in one go.

thank you

Anytime. You did the right thing checking before touching the pool settings.

A copy of this whole conversation comes to your email once we're done here, so you'll have it in writing.
I appreciate you help

Glad to help, and thanks for your patience with us.

Watch your inbox and this chat for the team on the pool email and the $50. If anything else lands that looks off, send it my way first.
